newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore PM says financial sector must liberalise.
newsitem.headline: Singapore PM says financial sector must liberalise.

text.p: Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong said on Tuesday the country's financial services sector must liberalise further if it was to remain attractive as an international financial centre.
Goh told a banking function Southeast Asian regional markets were liberalising, increasing competition in Singapore's financial sector.
"Singapore's financial services sector, although already one of the most open in the world, will have to liberalise further to remain attractive," he said.
Goh said local banks "should prepare for more domestic competition, go regional and explore non-traditional activities like investment banking".
They should establish wider networks in the region and forge strategic alliances with regional partners, he said.
"They will need to enlarge their capital base substantially and expand their asset size in order to compete internationally," he said.
